en: A color night-time illustration of a European city square with cobblestone pavement and surrounding multi‑story buildings with steep red roofs and glowing windows. In the center stands a dark statue on a pedestal, encircled by a low fountain or steps and several pedestrians. Gas or early electric streetlamps illuminate the scene. In the background, on a hill above the roofs, is a fortress or castle silhouette under a cloudy sky with a bright full moon.
